environment.description: Service deployed in a minimal container with pivot_root(2) into /srv/jail at PID 1 init, bind-mounted with MS_RDONLY|MS_NOSUID on /srv/jail/app/data (the only populated directory). The container uses a custom seccomp profile that allows only read(2), write(2), openat(2) with restricted flags (O_RDONLY, paths resolved relative to /srv/jail), close(2), fstat(2), mmap(2), epoll_ctl(2), epoll_wait(2), accept4(2), socket(2), bind(2), listen(2), futex(2), and blocks all others including symlink resolution syscalls (readlinkat, linkat). The /srv/jail root contains only: /srv/jail/app/data/ (empty user upload dir), /srv/jail/app/bin/service (the binary), /srv/jail/proc (procfs not mounted). No /etc, no credentials, no environment variables with secrets. Process runs with PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS and capabilities dropped to empty set. The OCI runtime spec sets rootfs to /srv/jail with readonlyRootfs: true.

config.seccomp_profile: allowlist: read, write, openat(O_RDONLY), close, fstat, mmap, epoll_ctl, epoll_wait, accept4, socket, bind, listen, futex, sigaltstack, rt_sigaction, rt_sigprocmask, clone(CLONE_THREAD only), mprotect, munmap, brk, getrandom, sched_yield
